items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2025! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2xBIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--740c53d289def878faa5292856a4438109c059dc/image.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing) * [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.pnwcubing.com) * [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.pnwcubing.com/competitions) * [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) * [Follow us on **Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/pnwcubing/) * [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/39HzT57upV) Warm Up Seattle 2025 is an exciting event for both attendees of the World Championships 2025 and folks who are not able to attend the championship. This competition is a **favorites** competition where you may register for up to 6 events (FTO does not count towards this limit). By registering for this competition, you should be aware of the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and this specific competitions [Competitor Responsibilites](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpSeattle2025#52996-please-read-competitor-responsibilities-schedule-explanation).

items.name: Warm-Up Warsaw 2025
items.information: Zapraszamy serdecznie na rozgrzewkę przed Mistrzostwami Świata! W ramach naszych zawodów będziemy układać dwie popularne konkurencje: 3x3x3 i Pyraminx. Mamy nadzieję, że uda się nam razem dobrze przygotować zarówno do oglądania jak i ukladania na najważniejszej imprezie tego roku. --- We invite everyone to warm-up before World Championship! In course of our competition we will compete in two popular events: 3x3x3 and Pyraminx. We hope that we will be able to properly warm up both for watching and solving at the most important competition of this year.
